usageDashboard.subtitle: Anonymous, aggregated usage of this Artemis instance during the last four semesters.

usageDashboard.empty: There are not enough courses yet to show usage numbers.

definitions.title: How these numbers are counted
definitions.course: A course counts if it is no test course, has at least 5 students and starts in the semester. Semesters with fewer than 3 such courses are not shown.
definitions.students: Students are unique people enrolled as student in at least one counted course.
definitions.activeStudents: Active students are counted students who made at least one submission in an exercise or exam of these courses.
definitions.privacy: Only totals are shown, never single courses or people, and results based on too few courses are hidden. The numbers are refreshed about once per hour.
